mutants.description: The UVLO bit is withdrawn during soft start once Vin is back. A restart after a recovered brown-out is taken to mean the UVLO was a routine power cycle and not a fault.
mutants.reason: Suppose UVLO is recorded while running, the converter stops, and it later re-enters S_SS with uvlo_state low. fault_reg[1] is then cleared before the host reads it, so the brown-out that interrupted operation is missing from the record. The same happens to a UVLO that interrupts soft start once it clears.

mutants.description: A host read clears fault_time only while the converter is in S_SS or S_RUN. A read after a shutdown clears fault_reg but leaves the old episode start time.
mutants.reason: After a fault stops the converter, the host reads the record. fault_reg reads back as zero, but fault_time keeps the previous episode's timestamp instead of 0. It stays wrong until a new episode overwrites it.
